receptor_pdbqt.description: Absolute path to the receptor in AutoDock PDBQT format (prepared with `prepare_receptor`).

ligand_pdbqt.description: Absolute path to the ligand in AutoDock PDBQT format (prepared with `prepare_ligand`).

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from upstream tools. Requires at least two items: the first's structure_path is treated as `receptor_pdbqt`, the second's as `ligand_pdbqt`.

center.description: Cartesian center of the docking search box in Å: `[x, y, z]`. Determined from a known binding pocket or computed via a pocket-finder.

box_size.description: Docking search-box dimensions in Å along x, y, z: `[sx, sy, sz]`. Each must be > 0. Typical 20-30 Å per dimension for small pockets.

exhaustiveness.description: AutoDock Vina `--exhaustiveness` parameter. Higher values run more Monte-Carlo searches (more thorough but slower); 8 is the default, 32+ is recommended for production.

num_modes.description: Maximum number of binding modes returned (`--num_modes`).

seed.description: Optional integer RNG seed for reproducibility (forwarded as `--seed`).
